Players Committee card image of [[Specter Of The Supreme Leader]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. The Phantom Menace is canceled. You lose no Force to Kylo Ren or Kylo Ren's Lightsaber. If Kylo (or Kylo Ren's Lightsaber) just lost, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to take that card into hand. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/specterofthesupremeleader.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
